sloka: प्राप्य च अस्त्राणि देवेशात् विश्वामित्रो महाबलः ।दर्पेण महता युक्तो दर्पपूर्णो अभवत् तदा ॥१-५५-१९॥
transliteration: prāpya ca astrāṇi deveśāt viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ ।darpeṇa mahatā yukto darpapūrṇo abhavat tadā ॥1-55-19॥

translations.english: Rajarshi Viswamitra endowed with supreme power became very haughty. Having obtained the weapons, his insolence was greatly accentuated.
